reader.requirement: At --std 85 each LINAGE data-name (page body, FOOTING, TOP, BOTTOM) must resolve to an elementary, numeric, unsigned, integer data item (no fraction digits, not an index item, not edited, not a group), possibly qualified, and anything else must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 chooses the 1985 OCCURS message citing §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR4 instead of §2023:13.18.34.3 SR1; same refusal
DialectLevel < 2002 cites §1985:VII.3.7.3 SR1 instead of §2023:13.18.34.3 SR2; predicate identical
below 2002 a sum counter can be the operand (judged by the shape screen)

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|Edition\. in ResolveLinage and LinageOperandShapeFault; the shape predicate has no edition switch.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the same predicate refuses the same operands; only the citation and OCCURS wording differ.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb524_linage_operand_shapes (legal DISPLAY/COMP) and pb5801 level 66; not exercised at 85 by them: signed, fractional, P-scaled, alphanumeric, group, index, edited, condition-name, OCCURS, subscripted operands.

COBOL2025 FOOTING 'D2' (PIC 9V9) ... not an integer data item
COBOL2025 TOP 'D3' is a category-alphanumeric item, not a numeric data item

COBOL2024 LINAGE clause operand 'D9 (1)' is written with a subscript

citations.check: python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:VII.3.7.3 SR1" "must reference elementary unsigned numeric integer data items" -> OK §1985:VII.3.7.3 SR1
python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR4" "Each table element reference must be subscripted" -> OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR4

reader.notes: LinageOperandShapeFault asks elementary, numeric, not index, integer (PicInfo.IsIntegerDescription, scale <= 0) and unsigned, in that order; every refusal probe was refused with the 1985 citation and the legal forms (DISPLAY, COMP, 9P, qualified, level 66 witness) compile and run with the right end-of-page result.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: lnbwz2 (PIC 99 BLANK WHEN ZERO, no VALUE) COBOL2025 'category-numeric-edited item, not a numeric data item' (cite.py --check "§1985:VI.5.4.4 GR2" "the category of the item is considered to be numeric edited" -> OK); lnftbwz (FOOTING operand BWZ) COBOL2025; ln66thru (66 RENAMES A1 THRU A2 of PIC 9 items, a group) COBOL2025; lnsum (a Report Section sum counter PIC 999, the 85-only operand arm) COBOL2025 'signed numeric data item', correct since the sum counter is 'a compiler-generated numeric data item with an operational sign' (cite.py --check "§1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR1" ... -> OK); lnsignsep (PIC 99) and lnfd (operand in the File Section, which SR1 does not bar) compile and run. cite.py --check "§1985:VII.3.7.3 SR1" "must reference elementary unsigned numeric integer data items" -> OK. No admitted form refused, no refused form admitted.
